description: GNSS SDR Signals Subject to Ionospheric Scintillations is provided by Depositing research team via Zenodo. The deposit provides GNSS signals acquired with a software-defined radio under ionospheric scintillation, a condition associated with amplitude and phase fluctuations and loss of receiver tracking. Geographic context: site; Lampedusa, Italy. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: not established on the reviewed page. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The earlier rejection treated GNSS observations as geoscience only; a navigation-service simulation role is clear, but this single study still needs Q2 approval. Potential simulation use: Calibrate positioning-receiver behaviour under space-weather disturbance. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnss-sdr offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
